title: Knight Waits for the Queen
setup: The queen on b6 props up the rook on d8 and the knight on b4, and your knight on c2 is watching b4.
hint: Knight takes knight is only a trade while the defender stays home. Which check sends it elsewhere?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxd8+}} leaves exactly one legal move, {{Qxd8}}. The queen is off the b-file, so {{Nxb4}} wins a knight outright. Rook for rook first, and the deflection is free. Ask what the opponent's best-placed piece is quietly being asked to hold.
